establishedBy.name: Class, section and academic session structure

preconditions.condition: The public inquiry form is enabled for the branch.

postConditions: An inquiry record exists with source stamped as Online Form, and it sits in the Pending Inquiries List awaiting review.
The inquiry is visible to School Admin for review, and to Staff alongside the inquiries they entered themselves.
The family's contact number is held against the inquiry and becomes the channel for every later message about this admission.
Where Re-admission was ticked, the previous student ID is captured and the inquiry is marked so the admission form step is skipped later.
The family has a reference they can quote, and has been told the school will be in touch.
No student record, fee record or account exists yet. An inquiry is interest, not enrolment.

dataFields.name: Child date of birth
dataFields.validation: Not in the future. Must satisfy the age range configured for the target class (BR-3).

dataFields.name: Target class
dataFields.validation: Classes accepting inquiries in the current academic session.

dataFields.name: Contact number
dataFields.validation: Registered mobile format. Every later message about this admission goes here, including the admission-form invite (BR-2).

dataFields.name: Email
dataFields.validation: Valid address. A secondary channel only.

dataFields.name: Re-admission
dataFields.validation: Where ticked, the extra re-admission fields are shown and the admission form step is skipped later (BR-5).

dataFields.name: Previous student ID
dataFields.validation: The system-issued student ID held when the child last attended. Checked against former student records (BR-6).

dataFields.name: Notes
dataFields.validation: Maximum 1000 characters. What the family wants the school to know.
dataFields.example: Would like to see the science lab before deciding.

dataFields.name: Source
dataFields.validation: Stamped as Online Form for every inquiry submitted here (BR-1).

dataFields.name: Reference
dataFields.validation: Quoted back to the family. Unique per branch and academic session.

entities.notes: One per submission, at status Pending review. Never hard-deleted.
Read to validate the target class and its age range.
Read only where Re-admission is ticked, to match the previous student ID.
The submission is logged against the reference, since no account exists yet.

permissions.notes: No sign-in required. They cannot see any other inquiry, and cannot return to edit this one after submitting.
See it alongside inquiries they recorded themselves.

permissions.rowScope: All branches. Pipeline reporting only at this stage.
No access. An inquiry holds a child's details before any relationship exists.

businessRules.rule: An inquiry submitted here is stamped source Online Form, so it is distinguishable from one a staff member recorded by phone or in person.
The contact number entered here becomes the channel for every later message about this admission, including the admission-form invite. It cannot be changed by the family afterwards.
The child's age on the session start date must fall within the range configured for the target class. The failure is shown while the family is on the form, not weeks later at review.
This is the only admission form a family can reach on their own. The full admission form is never public and is opened only by invitation.
Ticking Re-admission shows the extra fields that case needs and marks the inquiry, so the admission form step is skipped later — the school already holds the information.
A previous student ID entered for a re-admission is matched against former student records. A mismatch does not block submission; it is flagged for the reviewer to resolve.
The same contact number and child name may not hold two inquiries open at once for the same academic session. The second attempt returns the existing reference.
The submission creates no student record, no fee record and no account. An inquiry is interest, not enrolment.
References are gapless per branch and academic session, and are issued at submission.

transitions.condition: The admin opens it for review (UC-02-02).

basicFlow.systemResponse: Loads the form with the classes currently accepting inquiries at this branch.

basicFlow.navigation: Inquiry form → Child and guardian details
basicFlow.userAction: Enters the child's details, guardian details, contact number, target class and any notes.
basicFlow.systemResponse: Validates each field on blur, including the age range for the chosen class.

basicFlow.userAction: Ticks Re-admission where the child studied at the school before, and enters the previous student ID, year last attended and reason for leaving.
basicFlow.systemResponse: Shows the extra fields that case needs and matches the previous student ID against former student records.
Checks no inquiry is already open for the same number and child, issues a reference, stamps the source as Online Form and saves at status Pending review.
Shows the reference on screen and tells the family the school will be in touch.
Places the inquiry in the Pending Inquiries List, where it appears to School Admin for review and to Staff alongside their own entries.

alternateFlows.condition: The child studied at the school before
alternateFlows.behaviour: The inquiry is marked Re-admission and carries the previous student ID. The admission form step is skipped later, because the school already holds the information (BR-5).

alternateFlows.condition: An inquiry is already open for this number and child
alternateFlows.behaviour: No second inquiry is created. The existing reference is returned so the family is not left thinking nothing happened (BR-7).

alternateFlows.condition: A staff member records the inquiry by phone or in person
alternateFlows.navigation: Login → Inquiry / Admission → Pending Inquiries → Add Inquiry
alternateFlows.behaviour: The same fields are captured on an internal screen and the source is stamped Phone, Walk-in or Referral rather than Online Form (BR-1).

exceptions.systemResponse: The class selection is rejected while everything else on the form is kept.
exceptions.messageShown: This class takes children aged 6 to 7. Check the date of birth or choose a different class.

exceptions.condition: The contact number is missing or malformed
exceptions.messageShown: Enter a valid mobile number. Everything about this admission will be sent to it.

exceptions.condition: The previous student ID does not match any former student
exceptions.systemResponse: Submission still proceeds; the inquiry is flagged for the reviewer (BR-6).
exceptions.messageShown: We could not find that student ID. You can still submit, and the school will check it.

exceptions.systemResponse: The form is not submitted and the first incomplete field is focused.
exceptions.messageShown: Complete the highlighted fields before submitting.

exceptions.condition: No class is accepting inquiries at this branch
exceptions.messageShown: Admissions are not open at the moment. Please contact the school office.

exceptions.systemResponse: No reference is consumed and nothing partial is stored (BR-9).
exceptions.messageShown: Your inquiry could not be submitted. Please try again.

sideEffects.effect: The inquiry enters the pipeline and awaits School Admin review.
The inquiry enters follow-up tracking with a first follow-up date.
The contact becomes addressable for admission messaging before the family is a student.

departures.requirement: The form is reachable without a session and must stay available through the admission window, when traffic concentrates into a few days.
The form is completable on a 360 px phone screen, since most families will submit from one.
An inquiry that never becomes a student is retained 3 years, shorter than a student record, because no relationship was formed.

openQuestions.question: Should the family be able to attach documents at inquiry stage, or only on the admission form?
openQuestions.assumption: Only on the admission form. The inquiry stays short so families finish it.

openQuestions.question: Should the public form be open all year, or only within a configured admission window?
openQuestions.assumption: All year, with classes shown only where they are accepting inquiries.

openQuestions.question: Is the target class a firm choice or an indication?
openQuestions.assumption: An indication. The Principal may approve into a different class at 2.3.

openQuestions.question: Can a family correct their inquiry after submitting?
openQuestions.assumption: No. The School Admin corrects it at review.

conventionsApplied.name: role-based-access
conventionsApplied.rule: Access is enforced server-side on every request, not only by hiding menu items. A request for a record outside the actor's permitted scope returns a 403 and the message "You do not have permission to view this record." A use case states additions and restrictions only.

conventionsApplied.name: branch-scope
conventionsApplied.rule: Every record carries a branch ID. Users see only their own branch unless the use case states otherwise. Super Admin, School Admin and Principal may switch branch from the header.

conventionsApplied.name: academic-session-scope
conventionsApplied.rule: Every academic record carries an academic session ID. Lists default to the current open session.

conventionsApplied.name: list-screens
conventionsApplied.rule: Every list supports search, column sort and page-size selection. Default page size 25; default sort is most recent first. Filters are applied before printing or exporting.

conventionsApplied.name: audit-trail
conventionsApplied.rule: Every create, update, deactivation, approval and reversal writes to the audit log: actor, role, timestamp, record type, record ID, before and after values, and IP address. Audit entries are never editable.

conventionsApplied.name: deletion
conventionsApplied.rule: Records are deactivated, not physically removed. Deactivated records are excluded from lists and lookups but remain in the audit trail and in historical reports. A record referenced by a financial transaction can never be deactivated.

conventionsApplied.name: validation-and-messages
conventionsApplied.rule: Field-level errors appear inline beneath the field on blur and on submit. Errors that block the whole action appear as a banner at the top of the form. Successful actions show a toast. No action succeeds silently.

conventionsApplied.name: dates-times-numbers
conventionsApplied.rule: Dates display as DD-MM-YYYY; date and time as DD-MM-YYYY HH:mm in 24-hour form. Times are school-local. Phone numbers are stored in the registered mobile format.

conventionsApplied.name: language
conventionsApplied.rule: All user-visible strings come from a resource file. No hard-coded text in any screen.

conventionsApplied.name: screen-states
conventionsApplied.rule: Every list, dashboard tile and report defines four states: loading, empty, error and populated. The empty state names what is missing and links to the action that creates it.

conventionsApplied.name: notifications
conventionsApplied.rule: All outbound SMS, WhatsApp, email and push messages are sent through the Messaging module, recorded in the sent-message log with per-channel delivery status, and use a named template. Use cases reference the template; they do not embed message text.

conventionsApplied.name: default-performance-and-retention
conventionsApplied.rule: Unless a use case states otherwise: a screen loads within 2 seconds and a save completes within 2 seconds at 200 concurrent users; lists paginate above 100 rows; financial and student records are retained 7 years; audit and message logs 12 months; every screen is usable at a 360 px viewport. Fill the non-functional field only to depart from this.

conventionsApplied.name: default-trigger
conventionsApplied.rule: Unless a use case states otherwise, the trigger is: the user navigates to the screen and initiates the action. Fill the Triggers field only where a scheduled job, an event in another module, or an inbound external call also starts it.
